note: Ship drops for the regular maps, split out of wikiwiki_map_catalog.json and keyed by map id, variant key and node label. They have no reproducible source: the Rust HTML parser that produced them was replaced by the emukc-scrape-wikiwiki-mapdata agent skill in 2026-06, and neither the skill nor the cached wikiwiki pages carry drop lists (their DROP TABLE section holds only difficulty, operation name and BGM). Rebuilding the wikiwiki asset used to wipe them - see commit ca027294, which froze the asset instead. They live here so that regenerating the wikiwiki asset can no longer lose them. Hand-maintained until a real drop source exists.
